description: Compact statistic display card showing a primary metric value, label, and optional secondary trend value with configurable color.

parameters.name: SubValue
parameters.description: Secondary value or trend indicator (e.g. "+12% this month").

parameters.name: SubValueColor
parameters.description: Colour for the SubValue as a CSS colour value — a var(--tm-*) token reference or a literal like #16a34a. Rendered as the element's own --tm-stat-subvalue-color custom property, which the base .tm-stat-subvalue rule resolves via var(--tm-stat-subvalue-color, var(--tm-text-secondary)): the value therefore always wins over the default colour regardless of consumer stylesheet order. (Before 2.8.26 this parameter took a class name, which no library rule backed — it could not win.) Only meaningful together with SubValue: the component THROWS InvalidOperationException for SubValueColor without SubValue.

examples.title: Stat card with trend
examples.code:
<TmStatCard Title="Total Revenue"
            Value="$45,231"
            SubValue="+12.5% from last month"
            SubValueColor="var(--tm-color-success-text)" />
